Maya R.: Heads-up: third-party pentest booked 2026-07-12 -> 2026-07-14 against staging. Need RBAC freeze window, KMS access pattern, log snapshot plan, remediation tracker owner, and retest slots.

Ben I.: I'll own the KMS + presigned workflow. Plan: narrow KMS key, presigned PUTs TTL 2h, require encryption-context purpose=pt-evidence. Example presign CLI: `aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence/staging-07012.tgz --expires-in 7200`.

Deepa P.: RBAC plan: create ephemeral role `pt_assessor_{vendor}` with read-only scoped permissions. Require MFA and session tag `pt:vendor`. Deny SSH and require recorded bastion for any shell interactions. We'll remove role 24h after window.

Liam K.: I'll run logs snapshot. Recommend capture from 15m before start to 45m after end. Will produce CloudTrail, app logs, nginx access, and KMS usage report. Will run `log-scrub --preview SECRET,KEY,TOKEN` and post a scrub summary.

Maya R.: Remediation tracker owner? Need weekly sync and retest calendar.

Liam K.: I can run the tracker and create a GH project. Propose retest options: wk of 2026-07-19 or 2026-07-26.

Ben I.: Quick KMS policy snippet to allow decrypt only for objects with purpose tag:
`{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/pt-evidence","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:EncryptionContext:purpose":"pt-evidence"}}}`

Deepa P.: Runbook summary (short): 1) Create ephemeral role per vendor. 2) Issue presigned PUTs for evidence uploads. 3) Require scrub + legal redaction sign-off before share. 4) Revoke role and rotate any temporary creds. 5) If active exploit observed, pause test and escalate to oncall.

evidence-bot: staging-snapshot created snap-330123 (id: snap-330123).

Maya R.: Thanks. Action items: Ben -> presign doc; Deepa -> RBAC runbook; Liam -> logs + scrub report + tracker board; Maya -> publish final ops checklist and invite for retest. Add availabilities to the invite. Ping here with blockers. :thumbsup:
